tools.name: board
tools.description: Read the game: your words still to find, the trap, the other words, and whether a clue is needed.

tools.name: give_clue
tools.description: Give the player's next clue: one word that is not on the board, the number of their words it points at, and one short line of table talk.

clue.description: One word, not on the board.

count.description: How many of the player's words it points at.

say.description: One short line of table talk (max 160 characters).

turn.fallback: Your clue is on the board.

tools.name: guess
tools.description: The player picks a word on the board.

tools.name: pass
tools.description: The player stops guessing this turn.

tools.name: ask_clue_a
tools.description: The board asks for the next clue.

reaction.prompt:
It is your turn in Word Clues. The game engine returned this state:
```json
{{output.modelState}}
```
If `status` is `clue_needed`, call give_clue once: `clue` is one word that links some of `yourWords`, `count` is how many it points at, and `say` is one short line of table talk. Never pick a clue that also fits `trap`, and avoid ones that fit `otherWords`. If the game is over, give no clue: say one warm line about how it went and offer another game.
